content: Increase in the Internet user-base and widespread adoption of smartphones in the country has led to an increase in the importance of social media campaigns during the elections. This is evident by the fact that in our dataset (Set $U$), we found that a total of 54 handles got verified throughout 61 snapshots. Moreover the average number of followers of handles in set $P$ increased from $3,08,716.84$ to $3,19,881.09$ over the 61 snapshots. Given that the average followers of set $P$ increased by approximately $3\%$ and 54 profile handles got verified in the span of 61 days, we believe that efforts of leaders on social media campaign can't be denied.
